objective: Execute Statistics → Legislation → Integrity → Reports & Insights → cross-linking in bounded micro-steps while preserving BetterMakati's accumulated product doctrine.

executionRules.cadence: One user 'Next' executes exactly one micro-step.
scopeCap: Research, implementation and whole-site QA do not happen in the same micro-step.
If a step expands unexpectedly, split it before continuing.
One focused verification pass, then stop.
executionRules.deployment: Do not manually deploy after every micro-step while build-rate pressure remains. Commit cleanly and report CI/deployment evidence separately.

doctrineAnchors: No sermons, completeness bragging or repeated guardrails in normal page copy.
Green-forward BetterMakati design with selective gold emphasis and strong opening statements.
One report = one synthesis; one report per featured card.
Official Makati sources first for Makati-specific records.
Canonical data first: barangays, Place Registry assets, services, projects, Accountability, City Monitor and Public Records are reused rather than copied.
Explicit typed relationships only; no fuzzy asset/place linking.
No political rankings, corruption/risk scores, guilt-by-association or inferred wrongdoing.

Cross-linking includes the wider BetterGov ecosystem: BetterGov for national context/tools, BetterLGU for cross-LGU/non-Makati context, and sibling local sites only where a canonical handoff adds value.

batches.title: Freeze Wave 4 plan and doctrine
batches.maximumScope: Planning only. No product implementation.
batches.stopWhen: Sequence, micro-steps, accumulated product doctrine, cross-function rules and explicit non-goals are frozen.

batches.title: Audit current Statistics capabilities and gaps
batches.maximumScope: Inventory existing Statistics page, barangay population data, city-comparison data, finance links and duplicated/hard-coded facts. No external research.
batches.stopWhen: A current-state statistics inventory identifies canonical sources, duplicates, missing dimensions and candidates for reuse.

batches.title: Define canonical city-indicator schema
batches.maximumScope: Schema only: indicator ID, value, unit, period, geography, definition, source, revision, comparability and relationships.
batches.stopWhen: One reusable indicator model can represent citywide and barangay statistics without copying display strings into pages.

batches.title: Inventory population and demographic sources
batches.maximumScope: Official-source research only for comparable population/demographic series under current Makati geography.
batches.stopWhen: Population/demographic source inventory has explicit time, geography and inclusion/exclusion rules.

batches.title: Inventory economic and business indicators
batches.maximumScope: Official-source research only for GDP/economic structure, establishments/employment/business indicators that can be stated consistently.
batches.stopWhen: Each candidate indicator has a source, definition, period and decision: implement, hold or reject.

batches.title: Inventory service, land and infrastructure indicators
batches.maximumScope: Official-source research only; prioritize measures that connect to services, barangays, facilities or Place Registry records.
batches.stopWhen: A bounded source-backed indicator set is frozen with no inferred counts from incomplete Place Registry coverage.

batches.title: Implement canonical indicator dataset
batches.maximumScope: Data layer only for the approved W4-1c/1d/1e indicator set.
batches.stopWhen: Implemented indicators pass geography/period/source validation and existing hard-coded duplicates have a migration disposition.

batches.title: Redesign Statistics landing around questions and trends
batches.maximumScope: Statistics page only. Use canonical indicators, strong visual hierarchy, charts/tables and concise interpretation.
batches.stopWhen: The page answers current scale, change over time and comparable context without sermons or duplicated data.

batches.title: Integrate barangay statistics
batches.maximumScope: Barangay-scoped statistical view only. Reuse canonical barangay data and indicator definitions.
batches.stopWhen: Applicable city indicators can be sliced to canonical barangays without pretending unavailable barangay data exists.

batches.title: Add statistics downloads and provenance integrity
batches.maximumScope: Downloads/source metadata only. No new indicator research.
batches.stopWhen: Displayed time series and comparison tables have reproducible downloads and source/definition metadata.

batches.title: Audit Makati legislation sources and current page
batches.maximumScope: Source and product audit only: official Makati archive, City Monitor legislative records, Public Records and current external-search fallback.
batches.stopWhen: Available record fields, archive limitations and duplicate sources are documented.

batches.title: Define local legislation registry schema
batches.maximumScope: Schema only for ordinances/resolutions plus typed council-session evidence: identifier, number, title, type, dates, official text, authors when stated, lifecycle events, session video/agenda/minutes relationships, civic relationships and provenance.
batches.stopWhen: Schema supports canonical local measures, reusable official session evidence and City Monitor links without inventing enactment, vote or mayoral-action status.

batches.title: Build first ordinance registry batch
batches.maximumScope: One bounded official-source batch of ordinances. No resolutions in the same step.
batches.stopWhen: The batch is source-complete for its declared period/topic and every record has a stable ID and official source.

batches.title: Build first resolution registry batch
batches.maximumScope: One bounded official-source batch of resolutions. No ordinance expansion in the same step.
batches.stopWhen: The batch is source-complete for its declared period/topic and every record has a stable ID and official source.

batches.title: Connect legislation to City Monitor lifecycle
batches.maximumScope: Explicit record-to-record relationships plus council-session normalization and transcript pipeline: backfill identifiable previous official session videos and ingest new official sessions; represent each session once in City Monitor; attach timestamped BetterMakati automated transcripts with provenance/model/date, allow BetterMakati reviewed transcripts, and never label generated text official. Link measures to session/video/transcript evidence only where the action is explicit. No fuzzy number/title or speaker-identity inference.
batches.stopWhen: Previous/current session-video evidence can be normalized without the false source-gap assumption; session records have provenance-aware transcript states for backfill and new-session ingestion; and canonical measures can link to exact session/video/transcript evidence without treating automated text as an official record.

batches.title: Normalize full official ordinance/resolution archive
batches.maximumScope: Official Makati resolutions-and-ordinances archive only. Enumerate every retrievable archive entry in a dated snapshot, normalize ordinance/resolution identity, reference, title and official document/source URLs, and reconcile duplicates against the existing 20-record seed. No topic tagging or lifecycle inference in the same step.
batches.stopWhen: The dated archive snapshot has a reproducible enumerated total and every retrievable item resolves to one canonical local measure or an explicit unresolved/duplicate disposition. Do not call the registry historically complete unless the archive enumeration itself proves that scope.

validation.completenessBoundary: Complete for the reproducibly enumerated official Makati archive result set only; no claim is made about legislative history outside that archive.

batches.title: Resolve and enumerate dynamic legislation archive
batches.maximumScope: Official Makati resolutions-and-ordinances archive only. Resolve the client-side archive data source or use a browser-capable enumeration path; capture every returned row into a dated raw snapshot with exact type/reference/title/item or document URL/UUID when exposed. No topic tagging, summaries or lifecycle enrichment.
batches.stopWhen: A dated raw snapshot contains every result returned by the official archive UI, with a reproducible total and exact duplicate/unresolved dispositions. If the archive cannot expose a reproducible export/result traversal, keep the capability partial rather than infer completeness.

batches.title: Normalize enumerated archive rows and reconcile seed registry
batches.maximumScope: Transform the latest dated raw Makati legislation snapshot into one canonical archive index: stable BetterMakati measure ID, official type/reference/title, official archive UUID/source URL, explicit official-document URL availability, and exact type+reference reconciliation against the existing Annex A ordinance/resolution seed. No topic tagging, summaries, lifecycle enrichment or page work.
batches.stopWhen: Every raw archive row maps to one canonical record or an explicit unresolved/duplicate disposition; every existing Annex A seed record reconciles to the same exact type+reference identity; output counts and identifier/reference uniqueness are reproducibly validated.

batches.title: Add legislation topics and civic relationships
batches.maximumScope: Explicit typed links to affected service, barangay, Place Registry entity, project/accountability record or public record only when supported by the legislative text/source.
batches.stopWhen: A small verified relationship set proves the model without broad automatic tagging.

batches.title: Redesign Legislation page around local records
batches.maximumScope: Legislation page only. Canonical local search/filter/browse becomes primary; external site search becomes fallback.
batches.stopWhen: Users can find and open BetterMakati-indexed ordinances/resolutions and reach the official text without leaving the site first.

batches.title: Integrate legislation into Search and Public Records
batches.maximumScope: Search/Public Records integration only.
batches.stopWhen: One canonical legislation result resolves consistently across global Search and Public Records.

batches.title: Audit Integrity, procurement and accountability overlap
batches.maximumScope: Current-state inventory only. Identify evidence already present in Accountability, Projects & Budget, procurement seeds, COA records and Integrity.
batches.stopWhen: Every current integrity concept has an owner dataset and duplicate/gap disposition.

batches.title: Define integrity evidence and entity schemas
batches.maximumScope: Schema only for suppliers/contractors, awards/contracts, ownership/disclosure references, audit findings and corrective-action evidence.
batches.stopWhen: The model supports factual relationships without risk scores, accusations or guilt-by-association.

batches.title: Normalize supplier and contractor entities
batches.maximumScope: Existing Makati procurement records only. Create canonical entity identities and award relationships; no beneficial-ownership research yet.
batches.stopWhen: Repeated suppliers resolve to one entity and procurement records retain exact source lineage.

batches.title: Research public ownership and disclosure records
batches.maximumScope: Authoritative-source research only for beneficial ownership, conflict, recusal or disclosure records relevant to implemented Makati procurement entities.
batches.stopWhen: Each candidate link is classified source-backed, unavailable, restricted or not applicable; missing data is not treated as a finding.

batches.title: Build audit finding resolution trails
batches.maximumScope: Existing COA/accountability findings only. Link finding → recommendation → management response → later corrective/status evidence where exact continuity is documented.
batches.stopWhen: At least one complete or explicitly unresolved trail demonstrates the model without inferred closure.

batches.title: Implement verified integrity relationships
batches.maximumScope: Only W4-3c/3d/3e verified relationships. No new research.
batches.stopWhen: Integrity entity graph links procurement/audit/accountability records with provenance and no broken targets.

batches.title: Redesign Integrity page around evidence
batches.maximumScope: Integrity page only. Replace standards-and-gaps sermon structure with searchable evidence, entities, audit trails and direct source links.
batches.stopWhen: The page surfaces what is documented, what is unresolved and where to inspect the record without labeling people/entities.

batches.title: Audit existing Featured Reports
batches.maximumScope: Content audit only of current reports, homepage/Reports presentation and underlying source links.
batches.stopWhen: Each existing report is classified keep, rewrite, merge into another synthesis or retire; no new report is written.

batches.title: Define report schema v2
batches.maximumScope: Schema only: one synthesis, headline, subheadline, date, paragraphs/sections, inline evidence, charts/tables, related canonical records, methodology note only when necessary.
batches.stopWhen: The schema supports a news/article reading experience and typed links to statistics, legislation, integrity, place, project and accountability records.

batches.title: Migrate existing reports to report schema v2
batches.maximumScope: Existing reports only. No new research except resolving broken citations.
batches.stopWhen: Retained reports use one-synthesis structure, inline evidence and canonical internal sources.

batches.title: Publish one Statistics-derived flagship report
batches.maximumScope: Exactly one high-quality synthesis using the Wave 4 Statistics layer. No report batch.
batches.stopWhen: The report makes one defensible claim, cites every factual basis and links back to underlying indicators.

batches.title: Publish one records-derived flagship report
batches.maximumScope: Exactly one high-quality synthesis from legislation/integrity/accountability records where the evidence supports a meaningful story.
batches.stopWhen: The report has one synthesis and distinguishes source facts from BetterMakati analysis.

batches.title: Redesign Reports & Insights landing
batches.maximumScope: Reports landing only. One report per card; headline, subheadline, date, Read more; strong carousel/list hierarchy and no overview/meta copy.
batches.stopWhen: The page reads like a high-quality publication index rather than a repository.

batches.title: Reuse Featured Reports on the homepage
batches.maximumScope: Homepage featured-report module only, reusing the same canonical report data/component.
batches.stopWhen: Homepage and /reports cannot drift because both render the same report objects.

batches.title: Resolve Wave 3 Civic Reports partial capability
batches.maximumScope: /civic-map/reports only. Replace volume/popularity-led emphasis with threshold-gated case outcomes, observation freshness and audit coverage where publication rules allow.
batches.stopWhen: The known W3R-CAP-12 gap is either closed by implementation or remains explicitly deferred because thresholds are not met.

batches.title: Define shared civic-intelligence relationship model
batches.maximumScope: Relationship schema/helper only. Typed references across indicator, legislation, integrity entity, report, place, barangay, service, project/accountability, City Monitor, public record and BetterGov/BetterLGU ecosystem resources.
batches.stopWhen: Relationships can be stored once and resolved without circular data duplication.

batches.title: Connect Statistics to canonical city entities
batches.maximumScope: Explicit relationships from implemented indicators to barangays, services, places/assets, budget/project records, reports and relevant BetterGov/BetterLGU comparison or national-data resources where semantically valid.
batches.stopWhen: A small verified set demonstrates reusable bidirectional navigation without inferred place attribution.

batches.title: Connect Legislation across the site
batches.maximumScope: Legislation relationships/backlinks only: services, barangays, places/assets, City Monitor, Public Records, Accountability and relevant BetterGov national-law/context resources.
batches.stopWhen: Users can move from a law/council record to the relevant civic entity and back without duplicate copies.

batches.title: Connect Integrity evidence across the site
batches.maximumScope: Integrity relationships/backlinks only: procurement, projects, Accountability, audit findings, places when source-specific, Public Records and relevant BetterGov procurement/budget/benchmark resources.
batches.stopWhen: Supplier/audit/entity evidence is reachable from the underlying record and vice versa.

batches.title: Connect Reports to their underlying records
batches.maximumScope: Report-related-record modules and backlinks only, including relevant BetterGov/BetterLGU continuation links when they deepen the report’s evidence or comparison context.
batches.stopWhen: Every report exposes the canonical data/record set it synthesizes, and applicable records can surface the report as analysis rather than source evidence.

batches.title: Extend global Search to Civic Intelligence
batches.maximumScope: Search indexing only for canonical indicators, legislation, integrity entities and reports; include deliberate ecosystem handoffs without cloning BetterGov/BetterLGU records into BetterMakati search.
batches.stopWhen: Search returns one canonical destination per entity and avoids duplicate title-only records.

batches.title: Integrate Public Records and documents
batches.maximumScope: Public Records/document viewer integration only for new Wave 4 source types.
batches.stopWhen: Primary documents are reachable from the record pages and record pages are reachable from document entries where identity is explicit.

batches.title: Run anti-sermon and design consistency pass
batches.maximumScope: Wave 4 surfaces only. Remove explanatory/meta copy, duplicate methodology, bragging and inconsistent visual patterns; do not add new functionality.
batches.stopWhen: Statistics, Legislation, Integrity and Reports share the BetterMakati visual language and let the records/features speak for themselves.

batches.title: Run Civic Intelligence human/relationship audit
batches.maximumScope: Wave 4 surfaces and cross-links only. Check source integrity, broken relationships, mobile/accessibility baseline and user journeys.
batches.stopWhen: Every Wave 4 surface has an evidence-based status and every canonical relationship resolves.

batches.title: Reclassify and close Wave 4
batches.maximumScope: Classification/closure only. Record complete, bounded, partial and deferred capabilities without inflating completion.
batches.stopWhen: Wave 4 is closed only to the extent supported by evidence, with future work reopened as specific capabilities rather than vague unfinished work.

immediateNext.title: Add legislation topics and civic relationships
immediateNext.maximumScope: Explicit typed links to affected service, barangay, Place Registry entity, project/accountability record or public record only when supported by the legislative text/source.

carriedForward.item: Wave 3 Civic Reports outcome presentation gap
carriedForward.rule: Do not silently close it during Statistics, Legislation or Integrity work.
Reuse canonical assets as-is; make only bounded corrections when a Wave 4 source proves a specific error.

planningStatus.note: W4-0 freezes the execution plan only. W4-1a is the first product-analysis micro-step.

ecosystemCrosslinking.betterGov: National datasets, visualizations, budget, procurement/price and broader civic tools.
ecosystemCrosslinking.rule: Handoff and contextualize; do not duplicate another ecosystem product’s canonical data. Keep the underlying official source visible.
